description:
About Our Brand & Products

STG Mugs is an online store dedicated to creating stylish, high-quality mugs designed for everyday moments and meaningful gifting. From coffee lovers to tea enthusiasts, our mugs are crafted to add personality, comfort, and inspiration to every sip.

We offer beautifully designed mugs that are durable, affordable, and perfect for personal use, gifts, branding, and special occasions.


What Makes Us Different

  • Premium Quality: Durable mugs that retain print clarity and withstand daily use
  • Thoughtful Designs: Stylish, trendy, and timeless mug designs
  • Affordable Pricing: Quality mugs without premium price tags
  • Easy Gifting: Perfect for birthdays, holidays, corporate gifts, and personal surprises
  • Affiliate-Friendly Brand: We value partnerships and reward promoters generously


How Affiliates Can Earn

Start with 20% base commission as an affiliate. • Sell 25 mugs and above total over time and above to unlock 25% commission.

  • No limit to how much you can earn
  • Earn commission on every completed order
  • Get paid for promoting products people already love
  • Perfect for content creators, bloggers, social media marketers, and everyday hustlers

The more you promote, the more you earn 💸

How to Promote STG Mugs

Affiliates can promote STG Mugs through:

  • Social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp)
  • Product reviews and unboxing videos
  • Lifestyle or gift recommendation content
  • Personal referrals to friends, family, and followers
  • Blogs, websites, and email marketing

We provide promotional support and brand assets to help you convert easily.


Other Information

  • Commission Rate: 20% per sale

  • No Joining Fee: Free to become an affiliate

  • Flexible Promotion: Promote at your own pace

  • Transparent Tracking: Every referral is tracked accurately

  • Supportive Brand: We grow with our affiliates


Lifetime Sales - Tiered System

Tiered commissions are based on accumulated sales, not single orders.

  • 20% base
  • 25% for 25+ sales

Note: We only ship mugs to United States, let your promotional country be based on the US only.
payout_period: Quarterly on the 15th for payout timing.
term_and_condition: I understand that this is a commission based program and I only earn when I generate sales.”
